Noah: Can we formalize SI co-sell claim rules for marketplace+hw leads? Tired of manual pings.
Elena: Yes. Minimal proposal: require source_tag, partner_ref, and one evidence field for hard-claims. Soft-reserve allowed 72h.
Harper: Add precedence: existing SDR owner > hw partner > marketplace > SI unless SI provides evidence.
Kai: Suggest dedupe key = partner_ref || company_external_id || contact_email. Intake returns canonical_id and dedupe_status.
LeadIngestBot: Ingested: lead_id=L-2026-01-08-301, source=azure-marketplace, partner_ref=az-9001, est_annual_value=62000
Elena: Compensation: provisional split for co-sell tracked in partners/si-fees-v1. Assume 10% up to 100k ARR credited to SI. RevOps to confirm.
Noah: API example for idempotent claim: POST /leads/{id}/claim {claimer: "si-9", type: "soft", ttl_hours: 72} -> 200 reserved or 409 conflict with current owner.
Harper: Action items: Elena publish ingest schema + sample csv (Thu), Kai implement dedupe response and webhook (Fri), Noah coordinate pilot list of accounts for manual exemptions.
Noah: Thanks all — aim to reduce friction and speed response. :rocket:
